title: New user? Start now · the AI Foundry ET-SoC-1 lab
description: What a new user of the AI Foundry ET-SoC-1 lab does (ask Roman for an account and a Tailscale invite, join Tailscale, type their username and give their coding agent the one prompt), a diagram of the three machines and four cards, and the prompt itself: the agent chooses a free machine and card, sets up a Claude on it with Remote Control, runs a first test, and keeps to the lab's rules; the lab is starting to log card use.
